savesHint: Only the Owner can save or replace the shared world. Unsupported files are rejected; empty slots cannot be loaded.
leaseHint: Take control before driving. Release is available only for your own lease.
toolbarHelp: Toolbars: use arrow keys, Home and End to move; Enter or Space activates. Tab moves to the next group.
dirtyHint: Apply this name before continuing, discard the draft, or keep editing.
draftConflict: This station changed. Reset the draft to review its current name before applying.
draftInterrupted: The session changed. The unfinished station draft was discarded.
sharedReplacement: This replaces the shared world for every participant, clears control and construction drafts, and starts paused. It cannot be undone here.
observerHint: Observers can inspect and change local view settings. Game changes require Owner or Operator access; saves require Owner.
waitForSync: Waiting for a synchronized world and map images.
recoveryHint: The game is unavailable until synchronization completes.
authenticationRequired: Authentication is required again. Enter your access key to join.
closePanelToTarget: Close panel to choose a target
unvalidatedPreview: Preview only. Placement and cost are checked on Confirm.
geometryFailed: Target could not be checked. Select it again to retry.
unavailableObject: This object is no longer available.
leaveFailed: Leaving could not be confirmed. Retry Leave game to sign out.
localAccessHint: Leave the key blank to join locally as Owner.
leaseRequired: Train control expired or changed. Take control again.
loadHint: Select a file to check compatibility. Unsupported data leaves the current game unchanged.
replaceWorld: Replace the current game with this save?
incompatibleSave: This save format is not supported. Prototype saves cannot be loaded. The current game was preserved.
referenceWorldHint: Explore the eight-direction rail loop and run, pause or step the calendar. Economy, trains and construction are not available yet.
operationUnavailable: This operation is not available in the spatial reference world.
savingUnavailable: Saving is unavailable for this reference world.
invalidSave: Invalid save data. The current game was preserved.
saveFailed: Save operation could not be confirmed. Check the connection and server storage.
soundFailed: Sound could not play. Try enabling it again.
toolShortcuts: Tools (with the map focused): I — Inspect; T — Lay tracks; S — Slope; G — Terrain; R — Remove tracks. Escape cancels the current preview, then returns to Inspect; it also closes an open panel or menu. Construction tools require permission to edit.
mapHelp: Focus the map for keyboard controls. Click an object to inspect. In Inspect, drag to pan; in every tool, use two-finger trackpad scrolling, middle-button drag, or Space + drag to pan. Scroll the mouse wheel, pinch the trackpad, press + / − (or = / -), or use the zoom buttons to zoom. Each zoom key press changes zoom by 25 percentage points (50%–400%). The wheel and pinch zoom around the pointer. Reset camera returns to the map centre.
constructionHelp: Select a tile, then confirm. Tools keep shared time running; use Pause when needed. 100 per changed tile; buffer extension costs 200. Removal has no refund.
assetsFailed: Map images could not load. Reload to retry.
pickTile: Select a tile on the map
pickObject: Select a map object to inspect
manualHelp: Manual: focus the map. Shift passes; Up departs; Down reverses; Left / Right choose a junction. Run advances time. Escape cancels.
visualSample: Visual sample by the pier: water, fence and slope. Winter ground and recoloring are local display options.
title: FreeTrain Online
subtitle: Web prototype
networkNotice: Inspect the world, operate the train and extend the siding. Changes are confirmed by the game service.
incompatible: Client and server versions differ. Reload after updating.
operatorSecret: Enter access key to join game
accessFailed: Access failed. Check the key and try again.
unresolved: A command outcome is unresolved. Review the refreshed state before trying again.
staleEpoch: The world was replaced. Reconnect and review the current game.
notAuthorized: Operator access is unavailable. Reconnect to sign in.
queueFull: The server is busy. Review state before trying again.
retryWindowFull: Command history is full. Wait before sending more commands.
requestConflict: This request ID was already used for a different command.
invalidInput: The command was rejected. Your draft is retained.
staleRevision: The item changed. Review the confirmed state and retry.
unavailable: Connection unavailable. Reconnect and review state.
catalogHint: Imported building families · select a height to inspect.
terrainWorldHint: Inspect or modify terrain, or use Track and Slope to preview and build railway.
emptyWorldHelp: Create flat ground at the global water level, with no rails or decorations. Defaults store 30 × 42 × 6 cells (the source dialog displays 30 × 30 × 6). Custom H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 1–64; water: 0–Z−1. Preview does not pause shared time; any world change invalidates it.
creationFailed: World creation failed or its outcome is unknown. Check the current world before making a new preview.
staleCandidate: This preview is out of date. Preview again.
creationBusy: Another world preview is active. Cancel it or retry after it expires.
heightmapHelp: Import an opaque, single-frame PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF (up to 8 MiB, 4096 pixels per side and 4 million pixels). Stored H/V: 1–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells. Brightness sets height; steep steps are lowered and slopes smoothed. Water uses one global level.
heightmapTerrainPreview: Resulting terrain heights and global water
imageFormat: Unsupported image or mismatched file type. Choose PNG, JPEG, BMP or GIF.
imageBytes: Choose an image between 1 byte and 8 MiB.
imagePixels: The image exceeds 4096 pixels per side or 4,194,304 total pixels.
imageAlpha: Transparent pixels are unsupported. Choose an opaque image.
imageAnimation: Animated images are unsupported. Choose a single-frame image.
imageInvalid: The image is damaged or cannot be decoded. Choose another image.
generatedHelp: Generate reproducible plains, hills or mountains from a signed integer seed. Relief sets height variation; feature scale sets the wavelength in cells; smoothness reduces fine detail. Stored H/V: 16–2048, up to 1,700,000 stored cells; Z: 8–64; water: 1–Z−4. Preview never changes the shared world; confirmation uses the exact previewed terrain.
coastHelp: Inland has no coastal sea. An island has sea around its entire boundary. Selected directions use the world compass, keeping other boundary sectors dry. Target sea coverage is measured before lakes and rivers (±5 percentage points). Channels may divide the landmass. Small maps or extreme settings may be impossible.
coastCompass: Overview compass: North ↖ · East ↗ · South ↘ · West ↙ (stored H/V view).
coastMetrics: Surface water: {water}% · Dry cells: {land} · Open water components: {seas}
coastCoverageImpossible: Sea coverage cannot be met on this map. Change coverage or use a larger map, then preview again.
coastTopologyImpossible: A connected landmass and coastal seas cannot be formed with these settings. Change coverage, seed or map size, then preview again.
coastBoundaryImpossible: The requested coast boundary cannot be formed. Increase map size or change coverage or coast directions, then preview again.
waterFeaturesHelp: Lakes and rivers share the global water level. A river crosses the map in the selected compass direction and joins any sea along that axis. Lakes and rivers merge wherever they overlap; isolated lakes keep a dry rim. Lake area is approximate (±1 percentage point or 25% of its target, whichever is larger). Decorative creeks are separate.
waterSettingsInvalid: Check feature ranges and available space.
lakeImpossible: The lake area or separating dry rim cannot be formed. Reduce lake count or area, enlarge the map, or change seed.
riverImpossible: The river or its banks cannot be formed. Reduce width, enlarge the map, or change seed or direction.
forestUnavailable: Select at least one available tree species.
forestHelp: Coverage selects a percentage of dry, reusable cells outside the starting area. Higher clustering makes larger groves. Each cell uses the species’ original scatter density; some selected cells naturally have no trees. Starting area reserves existing level land and does not reshape terrain. Other foliage is unavailable until its installed recipes are reviewed.
forestMetrics: Eligible: {eligible} · Selected: {mask} · Forest cells: {forests} · Trees: {trees} · Reserved: {reserved} · Largest level patch before forests: {flat}
forestLegend: Overview: dark green = realized forest treatments · gold = reserved starting area.
startingAreaImpossible: A connected level starting area of this size cannot be found. Reduce its size or change terrain, seed or map size.
generationCancelled: Preview cancelled. The shared world is unchanged.
worldTopDownPreview: North-up terrain overview of the retained candidate
worldIsometricPreview: Isometric terrain overview of the retained candidate
worldPreviewSampling: Terrain overview: one sample per {step} stored cells on each axis. Blue: water; dark green: forest; gold: reserved starting area. Metrics cover the entire map.
realizedCoverage: Realized water: {water}% · Forest cells: {forest}% · Ground height: {min}–{max}
realizedBuildable: Clear flat dry cells: {flat} · Largest connected level area: {connected}
buildableHelp: Clear areas exclude forest treatments and other decorations, and connect through world-cell faces at the same height. Tool legality, ownership and costs are checked when you build.
cornerHelp: Pick a ground diamond near a corner, or enter the cell X/Y/Z for its northeast corner. Ctrl reverses Raise/Lower when picking. Shift + drag collects up to 64 sites in movement order; release stops collection. You can also add coordinates. Review, then Confirm the whole stroke. Heights use quarter levels in NE, SE, SW, NW order.
cornerLegal: Corner change is legal. Review the affected cells, then confirm.
cornerUnmatched: The touching corners have different heights.
cornerFloor: The world floor cannot be lowered.
cornerRoof: This corner would exceed the world height.
cornerStale: Terrain changed. Preview again before confirming.
cornerCapacity: This change exceeds a terrain or identity limit.
rectanglePickEnd: Pick the opposite endpoint at the anchor level.
rectangleInvalid: Use integer coordinates inside the map, with at most 64 cells in the inclusive rectangle.
repairInconsistent: Neighbor corner heights disagree; this cell cannot be repaired.
repairUnrepresentable: The matching height is outside this cell’s quarter-height range.
rectangleHelp: Pick two endpoints or enter coordinates. Endpoints are normalized at the first Z. Raise/Excavate visit shared corners before the far edges; Repair includes both endpoints. At most 64 selected cells. Ctrl on the second pick chooses Repair; Shift selects the half-height upper profile. Review changes, losses and skipped sites, then Confirm once. A failed cell is skipped; valid sites publish together.
terraceHelp: Place a terrace directly on bare ground or a slope; no corner stroke is needed. Remove it to restore its saved corners, or make and restore a cut. Changes remove forest decoration and ownership. Select a tile or enter its voxel coordinates, preview, then confirm. Water does not restrict these tools.
terraceRequired: Select a terrace voxel below its raised ground.
higherNeighbor: A neighboring ground level is higher than this slope.
authoringHelp: The Owner controls this saved world mode. Everyone keeps their existing permissions. Terrain rules and shared time still apply.
authoringEnterReview: Enable authoring for this world? This clears all participants’ terrain previews without pausing shared time.
authoringExitReview: Disable authoring for this world? Terrain previews will be cleared. Authored scenery is kept.
authoringDecorationsHelp: Select two map points or enter coordinates. Forest: up to 64 cells. Creek: up to 64 route cells at one height; blocked cells are skipped without rerouting. These initialize unowned scenery at zero cost. Trees may grow on underwater ground. A zero-tree result leaves that cell unchanged. Creeks do not change water or ground levels.
authoringInvalid: Use whole-number coordinates at one ground height. Select at most 64 forest cells or 64 creek route cells, and choose an available tree treatment.
authoringLegal: Scenery changes are ready. Review changed and skipped cells, then confirm.
terraceBatchHelp: Select two map corners or enter start and end coordinates, including both endpoints (up to 64 cells). Bare ground and existing slopes at the selected height become terraces, without a corner stroke first. Occupied or otherwise ineligible cells are skipped. Review the highlighted cells and forest/ownership loss, then confirm once.
terraceBatchInvalid: Use integer coordinates inside the map at one height, with at most 64 cells in the inclusive rectangle.
terraceBatchReady: Terraces are ready to place. Review changed and skipped cells, then confirm.
terrainPaintHelp: Hold the left mouse button and move over the map to raise or lower the corner under the brush in quarter-level steps. Holding still repeats the change. Shift + left drag reverses the action. Painting changes the shared world immediately and can remove forests or ownership. Release or press Escape to stop; completed changes remain. Coordinates below offer a preview-and-confirm alternative.
paintReady: Hold and drag on the map to paint.
paintBlocked: This point cannot change further. Move the brush.
paintFailed: Painting stopped. Check the connection or terrain, then start a new stroke.
mixedWorldHint: Build, remove and inspect normal track and four-position slopes. Shape terrain before laying railway; special infrastructure follows in later steps.
railHelp: Pick A, then B on the map, or enter X/Y coordinates. The start level is detected automatically. Enter a level to override it, then preview, review and confirm.
railHeuristicHelp: Compares the two shortest eight-direction paths between your exact points. Prefers a legal path, then the lower cost; ties use diagonal first. It does not search longer detours. The start needs existing rail or ground at or above the construction level.
railRemovalHelp: Removal uses diagonal first unless you explicitly select straight first. Every visited pier below the selected level is removed, regardless of its owner. Some protected or special rails remain and may still be charged. Review the full loss list.
railCutHelp: Auto detects the ground or existing rail at A within the height cut; B stays at that level. Enter a level for manual plane picking, including elevated or underground track. Change the height cut in View to inspect buried track. Preview and cancel never change shared time. Space + drag or middle drag pans the map.
railLegal: This route is legal. Review and confirm.
railStale: The world changed. Preview the route again.
railProtected: Rails occupied by cars are preserved; piers below visited cells are still removed.
railNoncoplanar: Both points must use the same level.
railStart: Start on existing rail or at or below the local ground level.
railUnderwater: The route crosses water at this level. Raise the level or choose another route.
railObstacle: An occupied terrain or structure cell blocks this route.
railMiddle: Existing rail may only be at the two endpoints. Split this route at the existing rail.
railAttach: The endpoint cannot attach in this direction. Choose a compatible angle.
railPattern: This operation cannot produce a valid railway pattern.
railBinding: A required railway definition or handler is unavailable.
railPlatform: A platform depends on this rail. Platform removal is not available yet.
railCapacity: The railway or construction journal limit has been reached.
railOverflow: The construction quote exceeds supported numeric limits.
railLevelWaiting: The first map point or start coordinates set the level. The end keeps that height.
slopeHelp: Pick a base on the map or enter X/Y and a level. The track climbs one level over four positions in the selected direction. Preview, review and confirm.
slopePick: Pick the lower end to build, or any ramp cell to remove.
slopeRemovalHelp: Remove selects the entire ramp, including invisible fillers and supports. A map pick detects its direction; keyboard coordinates must match the uphill direction. Normal Track removal does not remove ramps. All piers below the base are removed, including other owners’ piers; review every listed loss.
slopeGhostHelp: Solid outlines show rail cells; dashed outlines show paired fillers or supports. Dotted outlines show new piers; crosses show pier losses. All eight cells remain occupied even where artwork is invisible. Use a height cut to inspect buried tracks.
slopeNotFound: There is no ramp at the selected cell.
slopeMismatch: The uphill direction must match the selected ramp.
terrainUnavailable: Terrain editing is not available in this world.
